reported.title: Freeze updates frozen value instead of holding last sample
reported.description: While D5 is held LOW the code assigns frozenC = tempC every loop, so the reported value keeps tracking the live sensor instead of freezing at the last sample taken before the button was pressed. The frozen value should be latched once on the press edge (or on the last sample before hold).

reported.title: ADC reference scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
reported.description: volts = raw * (5.0/1023.0) overstates the voltage by ~0.1% (up to ~5 mV at full scale), which is ~0.5 °C error at the top of the range; the correct divisor for a 10-bit ADC is 1024.0.

reported.title: Sample counter increments every loop, not per second
reported.description: samples++ runs on every loop iteration (thousands per second), so `weather n=` reports a meaningless rapidly-growing count rather than the number of 1-second samples; it should increment once per print period.

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
